focused_tests.scope: Synthetic observer/controller, keyboard guard and ACTIVE verification tests

owned_x11_fixture.active_acknowledgment: Synthetic ACTIVE metadata after the owned window received Enter

authority_boundary.on_permits: Owned same-goal PAUSED with latest INTERRUPTED turn and null error after an observed ACTIVE baseline
authority_boundary.intent_limitation: Goal metadata has no pause reason and cannot distinguish accidental from deliberate Escape
authority_boundary.intentional_stop: Use OFF before intentionally stopping or pausing the goal

limits: Owned X11 acceptance verifies one guarded keyboard delivery and synthetic ACTIVE acknowledgment, not a native goal transition.
Fixture target observation does not qualify full live GNOME/TTY observation, asynchronous UI generation handling or provider recovery.
The post-install observation verifies the running helper recognizes a busy qualified terminal and sends no goal command in that observation.
Natural automatic live goal recovery and useful progress remain unverified.
